page.overview:
Who is Bart-Beard the Pirate?

Bart-Beard the Pirate was a pirate and a member of the Simpson family.

While investigating the Simpson family herritage, Lisa found a photo of Bart-Beard the Pirate.

He is deceased, as pirates lived in the 1500’s.
